entities.summary: Jordi Villacampa Amorós is a Spanish retired professional basketball player of Joventut Badalona, and former chairman of the club. At 1.96 m tall, he played as a shooting guard-small forward. His main skills and attributes as a player were his speed and a good long-distance shot. Villacampa is widely considered one of the best European swingmen of his generation.
